_help: Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\storages\session-cost-pricing.json (or $DSH_HOME/storages/session-cost-pricing.json) and edit. Prices are per 1,000,000 tokens in the currency named below. Peak = Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, excluding the dates in "holidays" and weekends; every other moment uses offPeak. A flat model entry {input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite} applies to both windows. Key lookup: "provider/model" -> "model" -> "provider/*" -> "*". Reloaded on the next board refresh; no restart needed.
